film.title: The Woman Who Wrote the Lobo Fight Song | Hardwood Bricks Spirit, New Mexico
film.description:
Spirit Week: New Mexico. Every fight song has a writer. Ours has a dean. Mateo Sandoval tells the story of Lena Clauve: Wabash, Indiana music teacher, UNM music graduate in 1925, the university's first Dean of Women from 1929, and the woman who wrote the tune for "Hail, New Mexico!" (words by English professor George St. Clair) for a faculty variety show that paid off the yearbook's debt.

Sources: UNM University Libraries, "And Yet She Persisted"; UNM Dean of Students history; GoLobos.

Music: original. Mateo Sandoval is a fictional AI anchor with an AI voice and is not affiliated with the University of New Mexico or any school.
